title: 1945 Prairie: the north bay's own dormered roof
items: The Armour-Corwith house at 1945 Prairie Avenue now carries its north bay up past the cornice under a slate mansard of its own, with two dormers in it over the bay's windows, as the Tribune's 1928 photograph shows. The stone cornice runs round the bay, and the bay's roof steps down to the house's.
The house's taller corner roof is still to come.
